ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity white (pixel values >200) central region against a 35% low-intensity black (pixel values <40) perimeter and base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central field (Type 2/3 classification). Irregular black pigment intrusions radiating from the peduncle base into the lower fluke field. Thick black border (approx. 5-12% of lobe width) follows the trailing edge with dendritic pixel streaks extending inward towards the fluke center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped median notch; approximate interior pixel angle of 82 degrees with a depth extending approx. 12% into the total fluke vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. Discrete macro-peaks (3-5 pixels height) visible on the distal third of the left lobe; right lobe exhibits smoother but still irregular pixel-level jaggedness.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex anterior sweep on both lobes; trailing edges exhibit a moderate concave curvature transitioning to sharp, elevated tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-contrast white/grey pixel clusters at the distal tips of both lobes, consistent with calcified barnacle colonization; distinct circular clusters visible at the apex of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast vertical linear marks (rake-like) on the white ventral surface of both lobes; most prominent as three parallel dark streaks on the lower quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Ectoparasitic calcifications (barnacles) localized at the lobe tips; irregular trailing edge tissue profile suggests minor historical scarring or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Single isolated black focal point (circular splotch) located in the upper central white field of the left lobe.
